correctness.rationale: The translation identity for energy distance is correct and gives continuity, positivity of the compact antipodal minimum, and \(\Delta_\mu(R)\le4R\). Borsuk--Ulam applies because \(q<p\), producing an antipodal encoder collision. The energy-distance triangle inequality forces one endpoint regret at least \(\Delta/8\). Same-noise coupling plus target translation makes the regret \((1+2L_eL_d)\)-Lipschitz in the covariate, so a cap of chord radius \(\Delta/[16(1+2L_eL_d)]\) has regret at least \(\Delta/16\). The beta-function cap formula and its \(t^{p-1}\) expansion have the stated constants.

originality.rationale: Henzi--Liu--Shen characterize distributional sufficiency through proper scoring rules, permit measurable one-dimensional encodings abstractly, and impose Lipschitz regularity in their consistency theory; they do not provide a quantitative impossibility floor for choosing \(q<p\). Classical nonlinear-width and topological-autoencoder results provide qualitative Borsuk--Ulam reconstruction obstructions in other losses. Fresh searches found no prior cap-integrated energy-score lower bound with a stochastic decoder and the explicit \((1+2L_eL_d)^{-(p-1)}\) scaling.
